title: Point Two Body Jam Serve (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance fusion 138bpm heavy bongo conga djembe slap bass spanish guitar pads synth lead trance buildup tribal claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro umpire voice]
Four two one we begin
Server down two points behind
Risk is the strategy
Serve to the body cramps the swing

[Verse 1 commentary]
Serve goes to the body fast
Why because body jam works at last
Receiver cramped no swing room
Return pops up like a bloom
Vamos vamos body jam
Uno dos tres no scram
Server steps in for the put away
Volley short into the open way

[Pre-Chorus]
Body jam
Pop up high
Body jam
Volley fly

[Chorus]
Point two body jam serve point two body jam serve
Cramp the swing cramp the swing
Point two body jam serve point two body jam serve
Vamos amigos make them sing

[Verse 2 coaching]
When behind on the score risk a serve
Body jam takes their nerve
Not every point not every serve
Only when you need the curve
Uno dos tres tactical play
Mano firme the body way
Follow the pop up to the line
Punch volley short and fine

[Bridge]
The body jam is high reward and risk
If you miss they get the gift kissed
Save it for points where you need a spark
The deep serve is still your mark

[Chorus]
Point two body jam serve point two body jam serve
Cramp the swing cramp the swing
Point two body jam serve point two body jam serve
Vamos amigos make them sing

[Outro]
Body jam
Pop up high
Volley short
Watch them sigh
